notes.title: Demo 1.1 Patch Notes
notes.notes:
Hi, dear appraisers!

Thank you so much for giving the demo a try. We appreciate your feedback and are working on incorporating it into the game.

We have just released an update for the demo fixing a few bugs and inconsistencies.

Fixes
[list]
[*]Fixed wording here and there and a few typos
[*]Minor quality of life improvements with nested dialogue menus
[*]Fixed a game breaking bug where player could get behind the shopkeeper with no way out
[/list]
Tweaks
[list]
[*]Added some more flavor texts
[*]Added a couple more sound effects to various interactions
[*]Background music will now continue to play in the pause/inventory menu
[*]Tweaked the tree puzzle
[*]Tweaked sound mix and reverb
[*]Screen fades are now slightly shorter
[/list]
